2BChoose the Meaning · Circle the clue that matches each word or phrase.

  1. 1

    traditional learning — a) The subjects and content taught at school. · b) A conventional approach, often led by the teacher. →

  2. 2

    mixed-ability classroom — a) A class with pupils working at different levels. · b) Using game features such as points in a lesson. →

  3. 3

    assessment — a) Learning new material at home and practising it in class. · b) A way to check what pupils have learned. →

  4. 4

    curriculum — a) The subjects and content taught at school. · b) Sharing many ideas before choosing one. →

  5. 5

    gamification — a) Doing a task with one partner. · b) Using game features such as points in a lesson. →

  6. 6

    flipped classroom — a) Learning new material at home and practising it in class. · b) Acting as someone else in a situation. →

  7. 7

    brainstorming — a) Advice or comments on how to improve your work. · b) Sharing many ideas before choosing one. →

  8. 8

    pair work — a) Doing a task with one partner. · b) A conventional approach, often led by the teacher. →

  9. 9

    role-play — a) A class with pupils working at different levels. · b) Acting as someone else in a situation. →

  10. 10

    feedback — a) Advice or comments on how to improve your work. · b) A way to check what pupils have learned. →
